name: citeladder
description: Evidence-grounded growth intelligence platform. Root manifest: a single entry point for the install, build, test, and lint commands of the Next.js frontend (frontend/) and the FastAPI backend (backend/). It declares no dependencies of its own and is never installed — pnpm's workspace root is frontend/, and Python dependencies are owned by backend/uv.lock.

scripts.setup: pnpm run setup:frontend && pnpm run setup:backend
scripts.test: pnpm run test:frontend && pnpm run test:backend
scripts.lint: pnpm run lint:frontend && pnpm run lint:backend
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:frontend && pnpm run typecheck:backend
